title: 第17章 萧家长老颤慄这只是楚风踏入修行一日的修为第18章 修仙下限武侠天花板
slug: 说好武侠世界你怎么教人修仙
lines: 萧府。
无数萧家弟子在此时齐齐抬头，看向天幕。
天空中密密麻麻影子，以及那瀰漫在府內各处的恐怖压力，都令他们难以呼吸。
所有弟子都像是被施了术法一般，死死的僵在地上，大气不敢喘一下的呆看著。
万柄飞剑同时飞悬在他们的头顶之上，如洪流天水洪流一般，一齐朝著大堂掠去。
此一幕，绝望，恐惧，惊骇，等等神色浮现在诸多萧家子弟的脸上。
无数子弟，在此时唯一一个共识。
那萧川眼眸中，印著数万柄飞剑，额头渗出一道冷汗，颤颤巍巍的道：
“完了，萧家惹上了惹不得的人！”
萧家大堂。
四人身子僵直，一动不敢动。
望著將日光都是遮掩了的万柄飞剑，四人都被汗水浸湿了全身，喉咙似滚轮般下咽著口水，难以置信。
萧斩瞪眼看著，胸膛起伏不定，不禁后退了一步，颤著声道：
“这世上，怎会有如此恐怖的威势。”
“后天？”
“先天？”
“不，这道气息，居然远超先天……”
他的视线回落在身前的青年身上，狠狠的吸了一口凉气：
“难不成，他真是一尊宗师强者？”
此道声音落下，不亚於平地惊雷，在四人的胸腔上响动著。
这个结论，是如此难以令人相信。
可现如今，事实就赤裸裸的摆在了他们的眼前。
簫火火崇拜的看著满天飞剑，双眼放光：
“这，这便是链气之境吗！？”
“我簫火火，將来也会做到这一地步！”
如此这般想著，萧火火神情激动，嘴角都快要咧到耳后根去了。
堂中的眾人，都是如此不淡定，震惊的模样。
唯有一人除外。
楚风依旧平淡如水。
他扫视了眾人一眼，看到眾人呆愣，甚至是有些僵硬的神情，嘴角勾起一抹轻笑。
与此同时，他身上紧绷的肌肉也慢慢的鬆了下来，內心鬆了口气道：
content_en:
Xiao Mansion.
Countless Xiao family disciples raised their heads at this moment and looked at the sky.
The dense shadows in the sky and the terrifying pressure that permeated every part of the house made it difficult for them to breathe.
All the disciples seemed to have been cast a spell, frozen on the ground, staring blankly without daring to take a breath.
Thousands of flying swords flew above their heads at the same time, rushing towards the lobby like a torrent of water from the sky.
In this scene, despair, fear, horror, and other expressions appeared on the faces of many Xiao family children.
Countless disciples, there is only one consensus at this time.
Xiao Chuan's eyes were filled with tens of thousands of flying swords. A stream of cold sweat broke out on his forehead, and he said tremblingly:
"It's over, the Xiao family has messed with someone they can't mess with!"
…
Xiao family lobby.
The four people were stiff and did not dare to move.
Looking at the thousands of flying swords that covered the sun, the four of them were all soaked with sweat, and their throats were like rollers, swallowing saliva, unbelievable.
Xiao Zhan stared at it, his chest rising and falling, he couldn't help but take a step back, and said in a trembling voice:
"How can there be such terrifying power in this world?"
"The day after tomorrow?"
"Xiantian?"
"No, this aura is far beyond the innate..."
His eyes fell back on the young man in front of him, and he took a deep breath:
"Is it possible that he is really a powerful master?"
When this sound fell, it was no less than thunder on the ground, resounding on the chests of the four people.
This conclusion is so hard to believe.
But now, the facts are nakedly before their eyes.
Xiao Huohuo looked at the flying swords in the sky with admiration, his eyes shining:
"This, is this the realm of chain energy!?"
"I, Xiao Huohuo, will do this in the future!"
Thinking like this, Xiao Huohuo looked excited, and the corners of his mouth almost reached behind his ears.
Everyone in the hall looked so uneasy and shocked.
Except for one person.
Chu Feng was still as calm as water.
He glanced at everyone and saw that everyone was stunned and even a little stiff, and a slight smile appeared at the corner of his mouth.
At the same time, the tight muscles on his body slowly relaxed, and he breathed a sigh of relief and said:
title_en: Chapter 17 The elders of the Xiao family are trembling. This is just the cultivation of Chu Feng after one day of cultivation. Chapter 18 The lower limit of martial arts cultivation.
